statement: Correct configured validator evidence in both Vibez history scans and publish a corrected immutable candidate for Fantasy Football MIG-009.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-01: Active configured history audit and preflight use declared validator identities and report actual missing and stale evidence.
AC-02: Unconfigured and historical records remain readable through their established readers; readonly diagnostics preserve records and fail closed on incompatible handoffs.
AC-03: Exact corrected immutable artifact passes the established Ubuntu and Windows Node 22/24 support matrix and independent QA, Architecture and UAT review.
AC-04: The corrected artifact reads the preserved rc.1 history without modifying it, and the documented handoff preserves consumer identities.
